title: Your rota, done in 3 taps
concept: Opens on the Sunday-night pain of a hand-scribbled paper rota, then a believable Fourmi phone demo: the week auto-fills in three counted taps, a shift swap is approved from a notification, staff clock in and payroll exports, before a 2,400-restaurant proof beat and a free-month end card. Warm cream/ink/ant-red art direction with an invented ant mark, finger taps with ripples, red wipe and iris transitions.
